verses.1: A gentle answer turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs up wrath.
verses.2: The tongue of the wise brings understanding, but the mouth of fools speaks folly.
verses.3: In every place the eyes of the LORD are watching both the evil and the good.
verses.4: A healing tongue is a tree of life, but folly in it breaks the spirit.
verses.5: A fool despises his father's discipline, but whoever keeps instruction is prudent.
verses.6: The house of the righteous is full of strength, and the offspring of the wicked are uprooted.
verses.7: The lips of the wise speak wisdom, but the heart of fools does not.
verses.8: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
verses.9: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the one who seeks righteousness He loves.
verses.10: Discipline is bitter to the one who leaves the path, and whoever hates correction will die.
verses.11: Sheol and destruction are in the sight of the LORD, how much more the hearts of human beings!
verses.12: The scoffer will not love being rebuked, nor will he go among the wise.
verses.13: A heart at peace brings a joyful countenance, but a heart full of sorrow makes the spirit droop.
verses.14: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of fools speaks folly.
verses.15: All the days of the afflicted are bad, but the one with a good heart has a continual feast.
verses.16: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great wealth with unrest.
verses.17: Better a meal of vegetables with love than a feast of meat with hatred.
verses.18: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but the one slow to anger calms a quarrel.
verses.19: The way of the lazy is like a thornbush, but the path of the upright is smooth.
verses.20: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son is a mother's disgrace.
verses.21: Folly is joy to the one without a heart, but a man of understanding walks uprightly.
verses.22: Plans are overturned without consultation, but with many counselors they will be established.
verses.23: Joy is in a person's answer, and how good is a word spoken in its time!
verses.24: The way of life is upward for the discerning, so that he may turn from Sheol below.
verses.25: The LORD will overturn the house of the arrogant, but He will set a boundary for the widow.
verses.26: An abomination to the LORD are evil plans, but pure are the words of the upright.
verses.27: A man who corrupts his house takes bribes, but the one who hates gifts will live.
verses.28: The heart of the righteous considers how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil.
verses.29: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayers of the righteous.
verses.30: The light in the eyes brings joy to the heart, and good news strengthens the bones.
verses.31: An ear that listens to reproof brings life, which is set among the wise.
verses.32: The one who ignores discipline harms himself, but the one who accepts correction gains a heart.
verses.33: The fear of the LORD is instruction in wisdom, and before honor comes humility.

notes:
Notes  
- v. 6: "offspring of the wicked are uprooted" — the Hebrew "נֶעְכָּֽרֶת" is interpreted as "uprooted" to convey the idea that their lineage or works will not endure.  
- v. 25: "He will set a boundary for the widow" — the Hebrew "יַצֵּב גְּבוּל אַלְמָנָֽה" is translated to reflect God's protection and care for the vulnerable, especially widows.  
- v. 27: "A man who corrupts his house takes bribes" — the Hebrew "בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע" is rendered as "takes bribes" to clarify the moral implication of corruption through receiving unjust gifts.
